stage.name: Ashy Marsh
stage.description:
With the flame called resentment cast into those overgrown reeds, the ashes quickly make their pursuit of those trekking through their homeland. Having heard their pleas for help, Rhodes Island will not stand idly by.
<Special Conditions>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Mire>Gradually reduces the ASPD of Operators within, and the ASPD and Movement Speed of enemies within.
<Reeds>Operators within gain Camouflage.

swamp_gloompincer.name: Swamp Gloompincer
swamp_gloompincer.flavourText: An Infected Creature commonly found in the swamps of Southern Victoria, known for randomly attacking travelers in the wilderness and posing a threat to the locals.
abilities: Immune to the effects of Mire; gains increased Movement Speed while in Mire

dublinn_flamechaser_elite_soldier.name: Dublinn Flamechaser Elite Soldier
dublinn_flamechaser_elite_soldier.flavourText: A elite Dublinn soldier fused with their Leader's ember. Chasing their Leader's ember even more fervently, their bodies are manipulated by Arts to ceaselessly rise from the dead.
abilities: Attacks deal additional Burn while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an Invisible <Ember of Fury> that must be damaged 5 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

dublinn_scout.name: Dublinn Scout
dublinn_scout.flavourText: A scout for the Dublinn forces. With superb concealment techniques, they are the cornerstone of the Dublinn forces' guerilla maneuvers. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.
abilities: Refraction

dublinn_cannoneer_captain.name: Dublinn Cannoneer Captain
dublinn_cannoneer_captain.flavourText: Captain of a ranged squad in the Dublinn forces. They use a modified standard-issue Victorian military crossbow fitted with a launcher for even more powerful explosive ammunition.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack deals Splash damage

dublinn_flamecaller_captain.name: Dublinn Flamecaller Captain
dublinn_flamecaller_captain.flavourText: An elite caster in the Dublinn forces extremely adept at manipulating flame, ignites everything around them, even their own deaths.
abilities: Attacks ignite Reeds beneath the target
When defeated, deals Arts damage to all nearby friendly units and ignites all Reeds

dublinn_scout_leader.name: Dublinn Scout Leader
dublinn_scout_leader.flavourText: A scout leader in the Dublinn forces. The scouts under their command are the cornerstone of the Dublinn forces' guerilla maneuvers. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.
abilities: Refraction

enraged_swamp_gloompincer.name: Enraged Swamp Gloompincer
enraged_swamp_gloompincer.flavourText: An Infected Creature commonly found in the swamps of Southern Victoria, more active than the regular gloompincers, known for attacking travelers in the wilderness and posing a huge threat to the locals.
abilities: Immune to the effects of Mire; gains increased Movement Speed while in Mire

dublinn_cannoneer.name: Dublinn Cannoneer
dublinn_cannoneer.flavourText: A ranged combatant in the Dublinn forces. They use a modified standard-issue Victorian military crossbow fitted with a launcher for explosive ammunition.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack deals Splash damage

dublinn_flamecaller.name: Dublinn Flamecaller
dublinn_flamecaller.flavourText: A caster in the Dublinn forces skilled at manipulating flame, ignites everything around them, even their own deaths.
abilities: Attacks ignite Reeds beneath the target
When defeated, deals Arts damage to all nearby friendly units and ignites all Reeds

dublinn_flamechaser_soldier.name: Dublinn Flamechaser Soldier
dublinn_flamechaser_soldier.flavourText: A Dublinn soldier fused with their Leader's ember. Long since dead, but Arts manipulation keeps their bodies moving towards their final desire, rising again and again.
abilities: Attacks deal additional Burn while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an Invisible <Ember of Resentment> that must be damaged 5 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

heavy_swamp_rover.name: Heavy Swamp Rover
heavy_swamp_rover.flavourText: A military vehicle capable of traveling smoothly through swampy terrain, fitted with advanced detection equipment and reinforced armor.
abilities: Immune to the effects of Mire
Reveals Camouflaged and Invisible allied units within range

dublinn_heavy_defender_leader.name: Dublinn Heavy Defender Leader
dublinn_heavy_defender_leader.flavourText: A heavy defender leader in the Dublinn forces, they wield much more sophisticated equipment. The armor technology they use comes from Victoria, while their boots were designed in Leithanien. Their shields look extremely similar to a newly patented product from Kazimierz's Roar Guards Company.
abilities: Refraction

dublinn_elite_spec_ops.name: Dublinn Elite Spec Ops
dublinn_elite_spec_ops.flavourText: An elite soldier under the command of 'The Brigadier.' The core of their ambush and assault tactics, they are well-disciplined and completely devoted to the cause.
abilities: Ignites Reeds upon passing by them
After several attacks, unleashes 5 consecutive slashes at the target

dublinn_flamechaser_elite_guard.name: Dublinn Flamechaser Elite Guard
dublinn_flamechaser_elite_guard.flavourText: An elite Dublinn defender fused with their Leader's ember. Chasing their Leader's ember even more fervently, the Arts embedded in their equipment make them hard to defeat.
abilities: Attacks deal additional Burn and takes reduced Physical and Arts damage while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an Invisible <Ember of Avarice> that must be damaged 10 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

swamp_rover.name: Swamp Rover
swamp_rover.flavourText: A military vehicle capable of traveling smoothly through swampy terrain, fitted with advanced detection equipment.
abilities: Immune to the effects of Mire
Reveals Camouflaged and Invisible allied units within range

dublinn_flamechaser_guard.name: Dublinn Flamechaser Guard
dublinn_flamechaser_guard.flavourText: A Dublinn defender fused with their Leader's ember. Long since dead, but the Arts embedded in their equipment keep them standing to fight for their ambitions.
abilities: Attacks deal additional Burn and takes reduced Physical and Arts damage while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an Invisible <Ember of Avarice> that must be damaged 10 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

dublinn_heavy_defender.name: Dublinn Heavy Defender
dublinn_heavy_defender.flavourText: A heavy defender in the Dublinn forces. The armor technology they use comes from Victoria, while their boots were designed in Leithanien. Their shields look extremely similar to a newly patented product from Kazimierz's Roar Guards Company.
abilities: Refraction

dublinn_spec_ops.name: Dublinn Spec Ops
dublinn_spec_ops.flavourText: A soldier under the command of 'The Brigadier.' Specializing in ambushes and assaults, they are well-disciplined and completely devoted to the cause.
abilities: Ignites Reeds upon passing by them
After several attacks, unleashes 5 consecutive slashes at the target

the_leader.name: 'The Leader'
the_leader.flavourText: Dublinn's 'Leader,' the life-burning Draco, the fear-evoking shadow. Do not let her close in on you.
abilities: [Rebirth] While on the field, some enemies will turn into <Embers> upon defeat and continue fighting
First Form

[Sovereign] Casts Exhausted Flame on a target, making them unable to attack or use skills, and dealing Arts damage and Burn to all allied units in a cross shape when Exhausted Flame expires or the target retreats
[Give and Take] Sacrifices up to 5 Flamechaser Soldiers and gains a temporary Physical/Arts Barrier proportional to own max HP based on the number of sacrifices.
Second Form
Gains increased ATK
Immediately ignites all Reeds on the field
Melee attacks deal damage based on doubled ATK
Both ranged attacks and [Sovereign] can choose an additional target
